overnightRisk: The next report is at ~02:00 COT, six and a half hours away, and the gap covers the thinnest liquidity window of the week — late US Monday into the Asia handover. Four specific things to watch. ONE, the immediate structural risk: price is sitting AT its session low, 63,320.1, having printed the low on the current bar with 15m RSI at 35.91 and the 15m MACD histogram at -37.13. There is 0.39% of air to the 233.49K pool at 63,070.56 and then a genuine vacuum — 62,375.96 holds only 120.94K — before the 535.77K magnet at 62,098.12. A stop-run that covers that whole distance is a 1.93% move, well inside a single overnight leg for an asset with a 2.59% daily ATR. TWO, the offsetting risk, which is the one that would hurt a short: the single heaviest pool on the visible surface is now ABOVE at 64,390.30 with 841.80K, and 24h Long/Short is 49.21/50.79, so the crowd is still fractionally net SHORT after a day that went nowhere. That is squeeze fuel, and it is why the futures book stays flat rather than short. THREE, the scheduled catalyst: the 03 Aug Farside row is only partly reported — IBIT, the largest fund by a distance, still reads '-'. When IBIT prints, a +58.7M day becomes either a convincing reversal of the outflow regime or a much smaller number, and that lands during the overnight. FOUR, the cross-asset one: today's Bitcoin bid was borrowed from an equity risk-on move (QQQ +1.76%) on Iran de-escalation. Headlines on that story reverse fast and Bitcoin trades through the gap while QQQ does not. Concrete plan: the spot core carries a resting stop at 62,050, below the 62,098.12 magnet, because a level that gets tagged and reclaimed should not take the position out but a level that gets lost should. Roughly 35 USDT of cash stays unspent specifically so a flush into 62,098 is an opportunity rather than a problem.

calibration.rollingRecord: The 12:45 COT midday report called range with a bullish tilt at 40/39/21 and HELD, and holding was right. Neither of its levels resolved into a trade: the 63,246 reduce never fired — session low 63,320.1, 74.1 points of clearance, so it survives literally into the endday print — and the 62,284 invalidation was never approached. The add trigger at 63,598 was TAGGED at roughly 21:00Z and its confirmation failed: price cut straight through and is 278 points lower, so a desk that bought the tag would be down 0.44% into an overnight gap. Midday explicitly priced that add as 'on weakness that HOLDS 63,598' and the holding never happened, so not buying it is scored as a correct non-action. Reaching further back, the 10:20 midday trim at 63,714.7 now looks good rather than merely neutral: spot is 63,320.1, so that trim banked 394.6 points, +0.62%, and the 35.12 USDT it raised is the only reason this desk has anything to spend on the 62,098 magnet tonight.
calibration.note: The calibration lesson of this run is about our own instrument, not about the market, and it is uncomfortable enough to be worth writing plainly. The midday report's headline finding — 'price is above ALL FOUR 4H EMAs for the first time in this drawdown' — was WRONG, and it was wrong for a methodological reason this desk should have caught: a 200-period EMA computed over a 250-bar window carries 8.2% of its weight in whatever value you seed it with, and seeding it at the first close of a window that began in a much higher price regime dragged the result 740 points too low. The corrected 4H EMA200 is 63,988.10. Price never reclaimed it. Two consequences are already recorded above: the reduce level has been re-anchored to a real object (the 63,070.56 pool) instead of a phantom moving average, and confidence is 5.60 rather than the 6.1 midday carried. The general rule now in force: any long-period EMA whose window is shorter than five times its period must be seeded from an equivalent-half-life average on a longer timeframe, and the naive and seeded values must both be disclosed. The second, smaller lesson: the desk took its own bearish 15m divergence seriously at midday and was rewarded with 568 points. It should keep doing that, including tonight, when the 15m says down and the liquidation map says up.
